GET /api/closings/company-receiving-acco.note: The company's primary-admin founder and an invited investor with a live commitment of their own on the venture read the masked instructions (scopeFor, bound to the caller). Another venture's founder or investor, a co-founder who does not administer the company, an investor whose commitment was withdrawn, an admin and the Super Admin get the same 404 a missing venture gets; a support session gets 403; no credentials or a disabled party get 401.

POST /api/closings/company-receiving-acc.note: Only an investor whose own line on the open closing has a completed envelope they signed sees the full number, and the reveal row is written before it is shown. A non-party, a withdrawn investor, an admin and the Super Admin get the 404 a missing venture gets; a party naming another investor's line, their own unsigned line or a line on another deal, and the founder, get 403 with no row written; a support session gets 403; no credentials or a disabled party get 401.
